record.question: K wants to buy L's car and drives it to test it with L seated by his side. Because of K's negligence an accident happened in which M is injured. M sues L for damages. In this case:
options: L is not liable as K was driving the car for his own purpose.
L is not liable as K was not the servant of L.
L is liable because he had not abandoned his right and duty to control the way in which the car was driven.
L is liable because K was driving the car for L's purpose.
record.explanation: L, present in the car and able to control how K drove, did not abandon that right and duty, so L is liable to the injured third party though K was not L's servant.
